name: Ekoï
verdict: French cycling-equipment company of Fréjus, founded in 2001 by Jean-Christophe Rattel, who has owned all of it since buying out his minority investors in 2019. Nothing found.
note: Kit manufacturer and partner of the team (also supplies helmets and eyewear). Rating note: owned 100% by its founder since 2019 (Fusacq); no human-rights finding against the company found.
